title: Protocol for the generation of murine bronchiolospheres
protocol: Euthanize animals by exposure to CO2 followed by cervical dislocation.
Sterilize the mouse thorax and abdomen with 80% ethanol.
Open the thoracic cavity to expose the lungs and heart using surgical scissors.
Perfuse the lungs with 20 ml of sterile Hank’s Balanced Salt Solution (HBSS) through the right ventricle until the lungs are free of blood.
Cut the lungs into small pieces (∼2 mm) in a petri dish for Acta2-Cre-ERT2; tdTomatoflox mice.
Place lung pieces from Acta2-Cre-ERT2; tdTomatoflox mice in 15 ml Falcon tubes and incubate with 0.5% collagenase type IV in HBSS for 45 min at 37°C while rotating.
Make a small incision in the exposed trachea of Scgb1a1Cre-ERT; tdTomatoflox mice to insert a shortened 21 G cannula.
Instill 1.5 ml of dispase through the trachea for Scgb1a1Cre-ERT; tdTomatoflox mice.
Remove the cannula and tie the trachea using a surgical suture.
Harvest lungs from Scgb1a1Cre-ERT; tdTomatoflox mice and place them in Eppendorf tubes containing 2 ml of dispase.
Incubate harvested lungs with dispase for 40 min at 20°C–25°C.
Remove the trachea and heart using surgical scissors.
Homogenize the lungs in 10 mL of digestion medium using GentleMACS® Dissociator (MACS Miltenyi Biotech).
Filter the homogenates through 70 μm nylon cell strainers (BD Biosciences).
Centrifuge at 500 ×g for 10 min at 4°C.
Wash the filters using 5 mL of DMEM if necessary.
Resuspend cells in 50 μL of anti-PDGFRα antibodies (1:100) or isotype control in MACS buffer for 20 min on ice in the dark.
Wash cells with 100 μL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge cells at 500 × g for 10 min at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 300 μL of MACS buffer.
Resuspend the cell suspension obtained from Scgb1a1Cre-ERT; tdTomatoflox mice in 300 μL of MACS buffer.
Filter cells with a final volume of 500 μL of MACS buffer using 40 μm mesh into FACS tubes for cell sorting.
Isolate PDGFRα+ tdTom+ cells from the lung homogenates of Acta2-Cre-ERT2; tdTomatoflox mice.
Isolate tdTom+ cells from the lung homogenates of Scgb1a1Cre-ERT; tdTomatoflox mice.
Perform cell sorting into FACS tubes containing 350 μL organoid medium using an 85 μm nozzle.
Centrifuge flow-sorted cells for 5 min, 500 × g at 4°C.
Resuspend the cells in organoid medium.
Adjust cell concentrations to 2×10^4 PDGFRα+ tdTom+ cells per 25 μL of medium per cell culture insert.
Prepare cell cultures by mixing both SCGB1A1+ and PDGFRα+ tdTom+ cells in 50 μL of organoid medium per insert.
Dilute the mixed cell population with cold growth factor-reduced Matrigel at a 1:1 ratio.
Mix well but carefully to avoid bubble formation.
Work as fast as possible to avoid Matrigel polymerization in the tube.
Add 100 μL of mixed cells and Matrigel on top of a 12-mm cell culture insert drop by drop, placing the pipette in the middle to ensure even dispersion.
Incubate for 15 min at 37°C to allow Matrigel polymerization.
Remove the insert and add 350 μL of organoid medium into each well.
Add ROCK inhibitor at a concentration of 10 μM to the organoid medium for 14–18 h, then change to regular organoid medium.
Place the insert back into the well containing the organoid medium.
Incubate at 37°C with 5% CO2 for at least 2 weeks.
Change the medium three times per week for at least 14 days to generate bronchiolospheres.
Keep bronchiolospheres in culture for up to 4 weeks.
